_comment: Pins the binary versions baked into the most-recent shipped .pkg. REQUIREMENT: bump the matching field (semver) BEFORE rebuilding a .pkg that ships a change — bb_vpn (the whole-package build identity: client/pkg-build/build.sh derives the .pkg filename and pkgbuild --version from it) on EVERY change to what the .pkg ships — client/bb-vpn Go sources, BBVPN.app/menubar, plists, scripts, bundled UI, or the baked-in control-plane token (patch for a fix or token rotation, minor for a compatible feature, major for a breaking bundle-schema change); and sing_box/xray to the exact upstream version of the binary dropped into client/pkg-build/payload-binaries/. client/pkg-build/build.sh's version-coupling check only enforces manifest<->binary AGREEMENT, NOT that you bumped — that discipline is yours, and bb-vpn --version is stamped from this field, so skipping the bump ships a new binary reporting the old version. See docs/release.md §2a. publish-bundle reads these to populate bundle.min_versions (publish-side skeleton-vs-binary validation is still a documented TODO in scripts/publish-bundle, not yet implemented). See docs/control-plane-bootstrap.md and Phase 4 of the plan.
